title: China's 'Robotaxi' System Outage Leaves Vehicles Stranded on Roads
text:
A “system failure” has caused a robotaxi outage involving multiple vehicles operated by Baidu’s Apollo Go in central China’s Wuhan city, local police said on Wednesday. This incident has ignited safety concerns over the fast-growing service.
